correctness.rationale: Direct substitution into rank-one factor R(X)=tr(BX)A reduces the defining identity to A²=λA, BA=uB, AB=vB, u+v=λ; u²=λu and v²=λv enforce square-zero or off-diagonal idempotent line over every characteristic. The factor space of a rank-r square-zero A has dimension (n-r)^2 and reciprocal-scaling quotient q-1; a rank-r idempotent has Gaussian image choices and q^{r(n-r)} kernels, with two disjoint off-diagonal B-spaces. Thus exactly the displayed N/I sums, plus one zero if counted. For fixed n>=3 degree of square-zero r=1 term is n²-2; P type at most 3 floor(n²/4) and smaller. First values (n=2,q=2):15 nonzero; (n=3,q=2):651 nonzero.
